name: dida
title: Dida 365
description: Manage Dida365/TickTick tasks and projects from Raycast, built on the public Open API.
author: daniel

commands.name: tasks
commands.title: Tasks
commands.description: Browse, search, complete and edit tasks

commands.name: quick-add-task
commands.title: Quick Add Task
commands.description: Create a task from one line, e.g. 明天下午3点开会 #工作 !high ~每周一、三

arguments.name: input
arguments.placeholder: 明天下午3点开会 #工作 !high ~每周一、三

commands.name: create-task
commands.title: Create Task
commands.description: Create a task with a form

commands.name: clipboard-to-task
commands.title: Clipboard to Task
commands.description: Turn clipboard text into a task

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Dida Menu Bar
commands.description: Today / overdue / high-priority task counts in the menu bar

preferences.name: token
preferences.title: API Token
preferences.description: Dida365/TickTick Open API token (dida365.com → 设置 → 开放平台)

preferences.name: region
preferences.title: API Region
preferences.description: China uses api.dida365.com, International uses api.ticktick.com. Same Open API.

preferences.name: qaProjectMarker
preferences.title: Quick Add Project Marker
preferences.description: Marker prefix for projects in Quick Add. Default: #

preferences.name: inboxProjectId
preferences.title: Inbox Project ID
preferences.description: The Open API project list omits Inbox. Enter this account's Inbox projectId (currently inbox1015263871).

preferences.name: qaPriorityMarker
preferences.title: Quick Add Priority Marker
preferences.description: Marker prefix for priority in Quick Add. Default: !

preferences.name: qaDateMarker
preferences.title: Quick Add Date Marker
preferences.description: Marker prefix for dates in Quick Add. Default: @

preferences.name: qaRepeatMarker
preferences.title: Quick Add Repeat Marker
preferences.description: Marker prefix for recurrence in Quick Add. Default: ~
